thread:
jen: Quick heads-up — planning a slim cutover for SDK v2.5 next Tue 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC. Goal is a low-risk rollout: 2% canary -> 20% -> full in 30m increments. Main user-visible changes: header rename `x-redwood-model` -> `x-rwd-model` (backwards fallback in client), and a small URL-encoding tweak for `prompt` params.

omar: Ack. I can own the canary bucket + smoke scripts. Will set up bucket in us-east-1 and the traffic split in envoy.

jen: Awesome — canary config: `canary_percent=2`, `regions=[us-east-1]`, canary duration 15m. Smoke script (run from ci-smoke or my laptop):
```bash
# basic generation smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small-1","input":"Say hi"}' | jq .choices[0].text
```
Expect non-empty text, latency < 600ms p50, no 5xx.

sara: I'll own docs + client comms. I'll update migration guide, changelog, and add a short note in the console release banner. Plan to blast customers with opt-in advisory for the header rename (link to migration snippet).

lee: Ran client compatibility tests this morning. Node and Python SDKs pass with the fallback header. One edge-case: older okhttp clients may double-encode querystrings for nested arrays — added a shim in `http-client` to normalize. Test matrix attached in CI.

akash: If we need an emergency rollback knob, I can wire a runtime feature-flag to force old header behavior for all traffic. Also have rollback playbook ready: `POST /admin/deployments/rollback {"tag":"sdk-v2.4"}` (internal only).

jen: Good. Owners: canary & smoke = omar, rollback ops = akash, docs/comms = sara, client compat = lee. I'll be primary deploy conductor.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window set for 2026-03-24T22:00:00Z (eng-platform). Canary route created: rc-canary-1839991111.

jen: Preflight checklist (please ack after verification):
- [ ] canary route exists (omar)
- [ ] smoke script green locally & CI (omar + lee)
- [ ] client shim merged (+ release candidate) (lee)
- [ ] migration doc draft (sara)
- [ ] rollback tested in staging (akash)
- [ ] oncall notified (@eng-oncall) (jen)

omar: Done on canary route. Smoke script pushed to `infra/smoke/sdks/v25.sh`. Will run one full smoke on Tue -30m and report.

lee: Client shim merged in PR #4857, pinned to rwd-http 1.12.0-rc. Tests green.

sara: Docs draft pushed to `docs/migration/sdk-v2.5.md` and changelog entry added. Will queue console banner for Tue morning.

akash: Rollback runbook verified in staging. I can execute rollback within ~6 minutes and flip the runtime flag within 90s.

eng-oncall: Noted. Oncall rotation for Tue night: @morgan (primary), @dave (backup). Morgan acknowledged.

jen: Final notes: keep the canary at 2% for at least two green cycles, watch model selection metrics and header-based routing. If any 5xx spike or >1% error rate vs baseline, halt and rollback. I'll post a short deploy summary in #eng-releases after completion.

omar: I'll post smoke logs under the thread and ping when canary goes live.

jen: Thanks — please reply with a one-line ack (e.g., "omar: ack") by EOD Fri so we can lock schedule. @here :thumbsup:
